# DistributedHierarchicalTemporalMemory

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A distributed implementation of Hierarchical Temporal Memory (HTM) where multiple HTM nodes operate in parallel across entities to learn spatiotemporal patterns for preemptive warning. Enables scalable, real-time anomaly prediction across distributed sensor networks, a core requirement for neuromorphic edge computing.
